THEOREM S3 (continuous-time conformal–Bernstein collision-risk certificate on the executed quintic, vs detected agents). MERGED STRICTEST PROOF. Adjudicator note: every load-bearing repo fact and algebraic identity below was independently re-verified against the source (see VERIFICATION) — the merge keeps the most conservative version of each step (proof-3 measure-theoretic care for the probabilistic core, proof-1/2 explicit deficit construction, proof-3 Remark on why the deficit object is necessary), and adds one limitation the three provers only partially captured (marginal-vs-calibration-conditional, §SEMANTICS G7).

=== STANDING OBJECTS & NAMED ASSUMPTIONS (the theorem is CONDITIONAL on these) ===
Committed trajectory τ:[0,T_h]→ℝ³ is the FIXED piecewise-quintic MINCO plan (M C²-segments). On segment seg (duration T_seg>0): local s∈[0,1], wall-clock t=cum_seg+s·T_seg is an affine increasing bijection onto I_seg; each coordinate τ_d(s) is a degree-5 polynomial. Detected, classified agents i=1..H (branch ① only). For each i, FIXED at commit: predictor centre x̂_i(t), normaliser ρ_i(t)>0, level α_i∈(0,1), calibrated split/Mondrian quantile q̂_i(α_i)≥0, tube radius r_i(t):=q̂_i·ρ_i(t), and pooled body/clearance radius r_body>0 (drone+agent+e_track, A4). True random agent path x_i(t). Collision C_i:={∃t∈[0,T_h]: ‖τ(t)−x_i(t)‖<r_body}.
(A1) Committed/future-independent. τ is flown only if the geometric certificate (Lemma 3) holds for ALL i (commit gate); τ,x̂_i,r_i are measurable w.r.t. commit-time data (agent histories + frozen predictor + calibration set), independent of the futures x_i(·).
(A2) Polynomial data OR conservative polynomial envelope. Case A (EXACT — what the code does): x̂_i,r_i are polynomials in s. The shipped SphereObstacle gives x̂_i(t)=c0+v t+½a t² (obstacles.hpp:32-34, deg 2); ρ_i affine ⇒ r_i deg 1. Case B (general/learned): there exist computable polynomials L_{i,seg}(s) with 0≤L_{i,seg}≤‖τ−x̂_i‖² and r̄_i≥r_i (conservative outer envelope; error folded into r_body/r̄_i).
(A3) Cell exchangeability. Within agent i's Mondrian cell (3 class × 3 density), calibration scores {S_i^{(1)},…,S_i^{(n_i)}} and the test score S_i are exchangeable; calibration is on TRACKER outputs, ONE sup-window per track, on Isaac onboard renders — NOT SDD.
(A4) Execution gap. The flown path stays within e_track of the certified τ deterministically (commit horizon < tau_trust=0.75s, repo field epsilon_track); e_track folded additively into r_body. (Read on the flown path ⇒ e_track=0.)
(A5) Classification budget. P(M_cls | ·)≤ε_cls from a SEPARATE label-set conformal procedure, where M_cls = a handling-relevant label (e.g. human) mis-set so the agent's hard regime is voided; consumed here as a budget term, its validity NOT established here.
(A6) Probability semantics. All probabilities are the Mondrian cell-exchangeable MARGINAL over the calibration draw + the exchangeable test future within the cell — NOT per-flight, NOT adversarial/closed-loop, NOT fully (calibration-)conditional (see §SEMANTICS).
SCOPE: executed quintic vs detected+classified agents only; FN branches ② (occlusion shadow r_occ+v_max·t) and ③ (depth/occupancy body-floor) are separate deterministic branches, OUT of scope.

=== LEMMA 1 (Bernstein toolbox; range/convex-hull enclosure — SUFFICIENT, not necessary) ===
B_k^n(s)=C(n,k)s^k(1−s)^{n−k}. (a) B_k^n≥0 on [0,1]; (b) Σ_k B_k^n=(s+(1−s))^n=1. (c) For p=Σ_k b_k B_k^n, at each s the {B_k^n(s)} are nonnegative and sum to 1, so p(s) is a CONVEX COMBINATION of {b_k}: min_k b_k ≤ p(s) ≤ max_k b_k ∀s. Hence max_k b_k≤0 ⇒ p≤0 on [0,1]. The converse FAILS: b=(−1/4,+1/4,−1/4) is the deg-2 Bernstein form of −(s−1/2)²≤0 yet b_1=+1/4>0 (re-derived by endpoint+linear-coefficient matching) — so the test is one-sided: it can only ABSTAIN on a truly-safe segment, NEVER certify an unsafe one. ∎

=== LEMMA 2 (control_points() = EXACT degree-5 Bernstein ordinates of τ) ===
On segment i the code (minjerk_traj.hpp:205-206) forms a_j=c_{6i+j}·T_i^j (D.asDiagonal()*cseg) then P=C2B·a. (1) a_j are the power coefficients in LOCAL s: position at τ_loc=s·T_i is Σ_j c_{6i+j}(sT_i)^j=Σ_j a_j s^j. (2) Power→Bernstein identity s^j=Σ_{k=j}^n [C(k,j)/C(n,j)] B_k^n(s) (verified for small n) gives b_k=Σ_{j≤k}[C(k,j)/C(5,j)] a_j. (3) The matrix C2B_matrix() (minjerk_traj.hpp:18-27)/60 EQUALS [C(k,j)/C(5,j)] entrywise — VERIFIED row-by-row (row4=[1,4/5,3/5,2/5,1/5,0], row5=all-ones, etc.). Hence P_k are the exact deg-5 Bernstein coordinates of τ_d on s∈[0,1]. ∎

=== LEMMA 3 (exact / enveloped Bernstein form of the deficit) ===
f_{i,seg}(s):=(r_i(t)+r_body)²−‖τ(s)−x̂_i(t)‖², t=cum_seg+s·T_seg. Construct degree-D coefficients {b_k}:
(i) τ_d in exact deg-5 Bernstein (Lemma 2); x̂_{i,d}(t) deg p_d in s — convert to Bernstein, degree-elevate to D1:=max(5,p_max). Degree elevation n→n+1: b'_k=(k/(n+1))b_{k−1}+((n+1−k)/(n+1))b_k is a CONVEX combination (closed form to any D: w_{kj}=C(n,j)C(D−n,k−j)/C(D,k)≥0, Σ_j w_{kj}=1 by Vandermonde) — EXACT and SIGN-PRESERVING, and raising D never breaks a valid certificate (Corollary: max_k b_k nonincreasing in D).
(ii) Subtract coordinate-wise (same basis, exact) ⇒ w_d:=τ_d−x̂_{i,d}, deg D1.
(iii) Square each via the Bernstein product B_a^m B_b^n=[C(m,a)C(n,b)/C(m+n,a+b)]B_{a+b}^{m+n} (Chu–Vandermonde normalisation Σ_{a+b=k}C(m,a)C(n,b)=C(m+n,k)), EXACT, deg 2D1; sum over d ⇒ ‖τ−x̂_i‖² in deg 2D1.
(iv) Form (r̄_i+r_body)² (deg 2q), elevate both operands to D:=2·max(5,p_max,q), subtract ⇒ b_k.
Case A: f_{i,seg}(s)=Σ_{k=0}^D b_k B_k^D(s) EXACTLY (D=10 for CA centre + affine radius). Case B: Σ_k b_k B_k^D = (r̄_i+r_body)²−L_{i,seg} =: g(s) ≥ f_{i,seg}(s). Every operation is an exact real identity (Lemma 2; product; elevation; equal-degree subtraction). ∎

=== LEMMA 4 (PART (i): all b_k≤0 ⇒ continuous-time clearance ∀t) ===
If max_k b_k≤0 then by Lemma 1(c), f_{i,seg}(s)≤0 (Case A) / g(s)≤0 ⇒ f_{i,seg}≤0 (Case B) for all s∈[0,1] and all seg. Thus ‖τ(t)−x̂_i(t)‖²≥(r_i(t)+r_body)²; both sides ≥0 ⇒ ‖τ(t)−x̂_i(t)‖≥r_i(t)+r_body. The segments tile [0,T_h], so this holds ∀t∈[0,T_h] (CERT_i). This is a DETERMINISTIC conjunction of finitely many polynomial-nonpositivity facts (D+1 coefficient checks per (seg,agent)); it is NOT a probabilistic union and incurs no time-grid penalty. NOTE (one conjunct only): CERT_i bounds distance to the PREDICTION x̂_i, and says NOTHING about the true x_i. REMARK (why the deficit object, not "control points outside the ball"): "all P_k∉B(x̂_i,R_i)" does NOT imply τ avoids that ball — the ball EXTERIOR is nonconvex, and conv{P_k}∋τ may dip in. The scalar deficit f sidesteps this because Lemma 1's enclosure applies to the SCALAR ordinates b_k regardless of geometric nonconvexity. (The repo's shipped local_opt_hardalm.hpp:236-268 instead enforces a frozen SUPPORTING-HALFSPACE per control point, g_h=R−aᵀ(P_k−c): also a sound continuous-time certificate since a halfspace is convex, but MORE CONSERVATIVE and a DISTINCT object from S3's exact quadratic deficit.) ∎

=== LEMMA 5 (split/Mondrian coverage; sup-over-horizon score collapses the time axis) ===
Score (one per track): S_i:=sup_{t∈[0,T_h]} ‖x_i(t)−x̂_i(t)‖/ρ_i(t) (x_i continuous, ρ_i>0 continuous on compact [0,T_h] ⇒ sup attained, measurable). q̂_i:=S_{(m)}, the m-th smallest of the n_i calibration scores, m=⌈(n_i+1)(1−α_i)⌉ (q̂_i:=+∞ if m>n_i). Under (A3), by exchangeability the rank of S_i among the n_i+1 scores is uniform; {rank≤m}⊆{S_i≤q̂_i} (at most m−1 calibration scores < S_i ⇒ S_i≤ the m-th smallest), so P(S_i≤q̂_i)≥m/(n_i+1)≥1−α_i, i.e. P(S_i>q̂_i)≤α_i (COV_i; ties only help ≤). TIME COLLAPSE: {S_i≤q̂_i} = {∀t: ‖x_i(t)−x̂_i(t)‖≤q̂_i·ρ_i(t)=r_i(t)} =: TUBE_i — a SINGLE scalar quantile covers the entire continuum of t, NO per-t union, because the sup over t was taken BEFORE calibration. NOTE: COV_i alone bounds only prediction error; the other conjunct. ∎

=== LEMMA 6 (PART (ii): the CONJUNCTION ⇒ P(collide i)≤α_i) — guardrail core ===
Events on the joint space (calibration draw × futures): certify_i (Lemma-4 cert holds; σ(τ,x̂_i,r_i)-measurable ⇒ FUTURE-INDEPENDENT by A1), TUBE_i (Lemma 5), collide_i^corr (correctly classified AND ∃t ‖τ−x_i‖<r_body). POINTWISE CONTAINMENT: on certify_i∩TUBE_i, the reverse triangle inequality gives ∀t ‖τ−x_i‖≥‖τ−x̂_i‖−‖x̂_i−x_i‖≥(r_i+r_body)−r_i=r_body (Case B: ≥(r̄_i+r_body)−r_i≥r_body since r̄_i≥r_i), so collide_i^corr cannot occur: certify_i∩collide_i^corr ⊆ TUBE_i^c={S_i>q̂_i}. Taking probabilities of the SET INCLUSION (the honest object — joint, not a naive conditional, sidestepping the conditioning fallacy because certify_i is future-independent): P(certify_i ∧ collide_i^corr) ≤ P(S_i>q̂_i) ≤ α_i (RISK_i). CONJUNCTION-ONLY: certify_i bounds distance to x̂_i only; COV_i bounds prediction error only; safety follows SOLELY from their coupling through r_i=q̂_i·ρ_i folded INTO the Bernstein non-positivity of Lemmas 3–4. Neither half alone is claimed. ∎

=== LEMMA 7 (PART (iii): Boole over finite agents + cls/pred split ⇒ ε) ===
A committed flight has certify_i ∀i (A1). The unsafe event U:={flown τ collides with some detected agent} ⊆ ∪_i(collide_i^corr ∧ certify_i) ∪ M_cls (if the label is right AND the tube holds, Lemma 6 forbids a hit). Boole (subadditivity — NO independence assumed) + RISK_i + A5: P(U) ≤ Σ_{i=1}^H P(certify_i∧collide_i^corr) + P(M_cls) ≤ Σ_i α_i + ε_cls. With the split Σ_i α_i≤ε_pred (e.g. α_i=ε_pred/H_max) and ε=ε_pred+ε_cls=0.08+0.02: P(U)≤0.10=ε. The union ranges ONLY over the FINITE agent index + the SINGLE cls/pred term; the continuous time axis enters NO union (discharged deterministically in Lemma 4 and collapsed into one scalar in Lemma 5). ∎

=== ASSEMBLY === Lemma 4 ⇒ (i); Lemmas 5–6 ⇒ (ii); Lemma 7 ⇒ (iii). Claimed ONLY as the conjunction. ∎

=== SEMANTICS / POSITIONING (honest scope, not theorems) ===
(R1) Bernstein non-positivity is SUFFICIENT not necessary (Lemma 1 witness) — conservativeness is one-sided (only over-cautious, never a false "safe"), shrinks under de Casteljau subdivision / further elevation, never becomes unsound. (R2) vs CP-MPC (Lindemann 2210.10254; Dixit/Stamouli/IA-CP 2502.06221): they place per-step conformal constraints at K grid times and pay a K-way Bonferroni/δ-T union (per-step level ≈α/K) with no guarantee between samples; S3 uses ONE post-commit sup-over-segment score per agent, so the time axis costs nothing in Boole — H+1 union terms independent of any discretisation. This is positioning, NOT a proved theorem, and NO firstness/novelty is claimed. (G7 SEMANTICS) The exact object (RISK_i / P(U)) is a FULL MARGINAL frequency over the whole pipeline (calibration draw + exchangeable test future). It is NOT calibration-conditional: split conformal gives only marginal coverage, so for a FIXED calibration set the per-deployment coverage fluctuates (Beta) and a training-conditional/PAC bound would need (n,δ)-inflation; and the per-COMMITTED-flight conditional risk P(collide|certify) carries an α_i/P(certify) factor, benign only because P(certify)≈1 by planner construction (operational, not proven). Probabilities are NOT per-flight/adversarial/full-conditional.

The Bernstein product (Chu–Vandermonde) and degree-elevation routines (Lemma 3) are absent. The SHIPPED hard certificate (local_opt_hardalm.hpp:236-268) is a strictly-more-conservative frozen supporting-halfspace-per-control-point surrogate (g_h=R−aᵀ(P_k−c)), a DIFFERENT object from S3's exact quadratic deficit; the always-on runtime monitor (reach_avoid.hpp:20) is K=8 SAMPLED, not continuous-time. S3 is proven as math but its certified object is not implemented; the current shipped path is sound-but-weaker.

LEARNED-PREDICTOR ENVELOPE (Case B existence assumed, not constructed). The proof is EXACT only for polynomial x̂_i,r_i — true for the shipped CA predictor (deg 2, obstacles.hpp:32-34), i.e. Case A. CLAUDE.md's intended predictor is LEARNED (generally non-polynomial); a sound conservative polynomial enclosure (poly centre + poly upper bound of error folded into r_body/r̄_i, WITH its own soundness proof) and the analogous treatment of a learned/time-varying ρ_i are NOT supplied. The W4 q95 gate is empirical, not a proof of the enclosure — a real hole for the headline regime.

NUMERICAL SOUNDNESS (floating-point sign of b_k). Lemmas 1–4 are exact over ℝ, but a machine certificate computing b_k in double precision can mis-sign a near-zero coefficient. A machine-sound certificate needs outward-rounded interval (or exact rational) Bernstein arithmetic through product/elevation/subtraction so that computed upper bounds b̄_k≤0 imply true b_k≤0. No such arithmetic exists in the repo.

EXCHANGEABILITY (A3) ASSUMED, not proven. The entire probabilistic conclusion rests on calibration↔test exchangeability within the Mondrian cell. If the agent reacts to the committed τ (closed-loop), x_i depends on τ and open-loop calibration may not transfer; covariate/domain shift (e.g. Isaac↔real, tracker non-stationarity, overlapping windows) voids coverage. Distribution-free worst-case-conditional coverage is impossible (Vovk; Barber et al.) — scoped, not solved.

MARGINAL vs CALIBRATION-CONDITIONAL / COMMIT-GATE (semantics, G7). The exact bound (RISK_i, P(U)) is a FULL MARGINAL frequency over (calibration draw × test future), NOT calibration-conditional: for a fixed calibration set, per-deployment coverage fluctuates (Beta) and a training-conditional/PAC guarantee needs (n,δ)-inflation. The operationally-relevant per-COMMITTED-flight risk P(collide|certify) carries an α_i/P(certify) factor (benign only because P(certify)≈1 by planner construction — operational, unproven). The three source proofs flag 'not per-flight/full-conditional' but understate this split.

BUDGET SPLIT / FEASIBILITY for H agents. Σ_i α_i+ε_cls≤ε needs a fixed/bounded H with a pre-declared split (α_i=ε_pred/H_max) or online allocation. For unbounded H, α_i→0 forces n_i large enough that ⌈(n_i+1)(1−α_i)⌉≤n_i, else q̂_i=+∞ ⇒ tube vacuously infinite ⇒ the certificate can never pass (safe but useless). This feasibility/budgeting condition is required but not established.

ε_cls PROVENANCE (A5) external. P(M_cls)≤ε_cls is consumed from a SEPARATE label-set conformal procedure whose validity (and whether the aggregate over H needs a Bonferroni split ε_cls/H or a joint argument) is delegated and NOT established in S3.

EXECUTION-GAP TRANSFER (A4). committed-quintic → flown-path via a deterministic e_track folded into r_body relies on commit horizon < tau_trust=0.75s and an empirical tracking bound (repo field epsilon_track exists, soundness assumed) — a named assumption, not proven.

CONFORMAL CALIBRATION ABSENT IN CODE. q_conformal/pred_margin is fed as a precomputed scalar (local_opt_hardalm.hpp); the actual split/Mondrian calibration producing q̂_i from a cal-set with the sup-over-horizon score is offline and not in this repo, so Lemma 5's coverage rests on an external calibration assumed correct.

FINITE-SAMPLE / HEAVY-TAIL TIGHTNESS (not a soundness gap). Small n_i ⇒ q̂_i=max (or +∞) ⇒ vacuously wide/trivial tube; one ID-switch outlier inflates the cell quantile. Effective per-cell n must be reported.

SCOPE. S3 covers ONLY detected+classified agents (branch ①) vs the executed quintic. FN branches ② (occlusion shadow) and ③ (depth/occupancy body-floor) are deliberately out of scope and handled by separate deterministic branches.

THEOREM STRIDE — Safety ⊥ winding-enumeration completeness (the firewall). A corollary of S3. The DECOUPLING (Lemmas 1–5 + assembly) is proved unconditionally and code-verified; the probabilistic consequent is the cited hypothesis S3; the continuous-time soundness of the moving-obstacle certificate is inherited (open gaps G1/G2). Every code fact below was re-verified by the judge against the cited file:line.

================= 0. OBJECTS =================
(O1) Trajectory τ ∈ 𝒯: piecewise-quintic MINCO curve from x=[q,T], durations DIRECT (minco_cost_grad.hpp:192). Per-segment degree-5 Bernstein control points P_{s,k}(τ)=C2B·diag(1,T,…,T^5)·c_s (minjerk_traj.hpp:197-209, C2B:18); control-point (Greville) times t_{s,k}(τ)=cum(s)+(k/5)·T_s (minjerk_traj.hpp:212-218). Both pure functions of τ.
(O2) Episode world O={o_i}: each o_i carries class, geometry (sphere r_i / AABB), CA motion γ_i(t)=centre0+vel·t+½accel·t² (obstacles.hpp:32-34), signed_dist=‖p−γ_i(t)‖−r_i (:38-40). Exogenous to enumeration (passed by const-ref identically to every candidate, plan_minco.hpp:1060).
(O3) Conformal/physical bundle Θ=(q_conf, ε_track, {d_safe(cls)}, τ_trust, safety_mode, …): q_conf=pred_margin (local_opt_hardalm.hpp:72-81), ε_track (:84), d_safe (:87). Fixed for the episode; carries no enumeration data.
(O4) Enumeration config E ∈ ℰ: DetourConfig (max_seeds≤5, plan_minco.hpp:159; single-H-signature passing_side :168; use_topology; st_NS/st_NT). Induces T_enum(E)={optimise_one_minco(σ):σ∈generate_detour_seeds(E)}⊆𝒯, |T_enum|≤max_seeds (cap :358), optionally × ST-graph timing.

================= 1. BARRIER + SAFE PREDICATE (two code operationalizations) =================
For sphere i, segment s, control point k, the hard-set ALM defines (local_opt_hardalm.hpp:236-248):
  b_k^{(i,s)}(τ;O,Θ) := R_i − a_{i,s,k}^T(P_{s,k}(τ) − c_{i,s,k}),  R_i = r_i + d_safe(c_i) + q_conf + ε_track (:237).
Two predicates, BOTH verified to read only (τ,O,Θ):
  (P-cert) Safe_cert(τ):=[max_{i,s,k} b_k ≤ 0] = [certificate_margin(τ)≥0], certificate_margin=−max g (plan_minco.hpp:963-968).
  (P-gate, OPERATIVE) Safe_gate(τ):=[check_feasibility(τ) valid ∧ max_breach(τ)+(q_conf+ε_track) ≤ tol], where max_breach is from hard_clearance_trusted — a DENSE (K≥200) signed_dist scan over [t0, t0+τ_trust] for movers / full horizon for statics (plan_minco.hpp:482-507, 915-919). The gate uses NO normals and is what actually sets trajectory_valid (the code states certificate_margin is telemetry-only, selection uses hard_max_breach+feasibility, :959-960).
S_θ := {τ∈𝒯 : Safe(τ)} for either predicate.

================= 2. LEMMA 1 (Locality / dependency closure) =================
Statement (drawn from Prover-1 L1+Remark-1a and Prover-3 Lemma-1, judge-verified): Safe(·): 𝒯→{0,1} is a deterministic functional of (τ,O,Θ) ONLY; it never reads T_enum, |T_enum|, the seed generator, DetourConfig, st_NS/st_NT, or any other candidate.
Proof. Dependency-closure of every argument of b_k and of the gate:
  • P_{s,k}(τ),t_{s,k}(τ),centroid_s(τ): τ alone (minjerk_traj.hpp:197,212).
  • R_i,q_conf,ε_track,d_safe,γ_i,r_i: (O,Θ) alone (local_opt_hardalm.hpp:72-92,237; obstacles.hpp).
  • signature evidence: alm_constraints/seg_normals/check_feasibility/hard_clearance_trusted take exactly (tr, hard_obs, avoid_cfg, [normals], opt[, K, τ_trust]); the ONLY .size() in local_opt_hardalm.hpp is hard_obs.size() (=H, :119,196) — no seed/enum count. DetourConfig is a parameter ONLY of make_detour_path (:272), generate_detour_seeds (:302), and top-level plan_minco (:1040); it is NOT received by optimise_one_minco/check_feasibility/hard_clearance_trusted/alm_constraints. The seed enters solely as alm_solve's initial guess (:895) and is consumed before any scoring; signed_dist is pure geometry (obstacles.hpp:38-40,60-70).
  Index ranges i∈{1..H}, s∈{1..M(τ)}, k∈{0..5} are fixed by (O,τ), not by enumeration.
REMARK 1a (back-door closure — the one subtle place, Prover-1, judge-CONFIRMED). During the INNER ALM solve the supporting normals are frozen from the running iterate (seg_normals on the iterate, seed-/history-dependent). That steers WHICH τ is returned, not the VALUE of Safe at a given τ: the REPORTED certificate recomputes normals from the FINAL trajectory itself — final_normals=seg_normals(trf,…), final_trust=trust_mask(trf,…) at plan_minco.hpp:803-809 with trf=rebuild(x) (:795) — and certificate_margin reuses these (:963-968). Since seg_normals(trf) is a pure function of trf, Safe_cert(τ) is a pure function of (τ,O,Θ). The gate Safe_gate is normals-free and (τ,O,Θ)-only a fortiori. (check_feasibility on a given trajectory is golden-tested field-exact, decoupled from optimizer/seed — test_plan_minco.cpp:8.) ∎

================= 3. LEMMA 2 (Enumeration-invariance) =================
Fix O,Θ. For any E,E'∈ℰ and any τ∈𝒯, Safe(τ) is identical whether computed in run E or E'; changing winding candidates / max_seeds / use_topology / |T_enum| cannot flip Safe(τ) for any fixed τ. Proof: immediate from Lemma 1 (Safe(·) is a single (τ,O,Θ)-function). ∎

================= 4. LEMMA 3 (Soundness of the certified set, every E, every completeness) =================
C(E):=T_enum(E)∩S_θ. For every E: C(E)⊆S_θ, and A(E):={τ∈T_enum(E):Safe(τ)∧feas(τ)}⊆C(E)⊆S_θ. Proof: S_θ is a fixed set (Lemma 1); for any X, X∩S_θ⊆S_θ; take X=T_enum(E). No use of completeness. The certified set is ALWAYS a subset of the truly-safe set, for complete and incomplete E alike — the precise meaning of "firewall." ∎

================= 5. LEMMA 4 (Execution firewall — main step) =================
Let τ* be executed. The architecture guarantees τ*∈C(E) (select_best_minco returns a trajectory_valid candidate by feasible-first argmin, plan_minco.hpp:981-988; on none-valid it returns least-bad with trajectory_valid=false, routed to RTA, :991-1007 + recovery.hpp:16).
